notes: Troubleshooting v354 extends the v353 machine-start work with source-backed internal Servo Bottle Table DataExchange diagnostics from CO85_LB1_Labeler_1online.L5K and K407039 page 142. Internal position 720 is explicitly retained as disabled because AFI blocks its only OTE in the supplied PLC revision. Positions 721-723 are indexed as active-but-unnamed internal statuses without inflating the 515 operator-named alarm count: 721 preserves the exact I0011.00 Encoder Simulation Off / sensor-simulation / OutServoPowerOnline semantic conflict, 722 traces missing System Online through I0011.03, and 723 traces missing Servo Ready through I0011.04 while the executable operating-mode bit is true. These are read-only diagnostic routes; no HMI alarm names are invented and no forcing, bypassing, timer changes, or unsafe recovery actions are recommended.
